title: Jason can get fat in GTA 6: the body system explained
yt_title: Jason can get FAT in GTA 6? 🍔 The body system explained
description: Can Jason really get fat in GTA 6? Yes. Food and exercise change Jason's and Lucia's bodies: eat a lot and they get heavier, hit the gym and they build muscle (Rockstar to Dazed, reported by Kotaku and TweakTown). One player even reached a max-weight 'True Fat Jason' on a burger and taco diet (Kotaku). The system comes back from San Andreas: GTA 5 tracked stats, but Michael, Franklin and Trevor never changed shape. Skipping sleep reportedly makes them look exhausted too (unconfirmed). No spoilers. Will your Jason be fat or ripped? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (partly unconfirmed): skipping sleep makes the characters look exhausted; any stamina effect is speculation.
